# AI-Coding-Complete

Using your own copy? Open `README.md` in this folder to start.

A full-size starter for building software with an AI assistant, the spec-driven way. It has all nine numbered folders, from planning to measuring, a backlog, handoff notes, and a worked example: a small website built from a spec, with a check the assistant runs before calling a task done.

*Step 3 of 3: the same method at the size of a real project.* Start with [AI-Coding-Lite](https://github.com/InstallGuides/AI-Coding-Lite) if this is your first spec-driven project.

It's one of the example projects from [Mac Install Guide](https://mac.install.guide/developer-setup/starter-project).

## Get it

**With an app.** The [Set Up Your Mac](https://mac.install.guide/set-up-your-mac/) apps create this project for people who write code, after they set up the Mac. In the Yaxed editor, choose **File > New Project**.

**Without an app.** Make your own copy on GitHub with **Use this template**, or download the `.zip` from the latest release and unzip it into a folder of your own.

## Use it

Open the folder with your AI assistant, then read `README.md`. Double-click `site/index.html` to see the example site.

## Feedback

Found a problem, or have a suggestion? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/InstallGuides/AI-Coding-Complete/issues). This project doesn't take pull requests.
